responsibility: This target header defines the main OpenBSD/sparc64 configuration. It selects the default 64-bit V9 target masks and code model, emits OpenBSD and sparc64 preprocessor builtins, sets assembler, linker, startfile, and endfile specs, and fixes ABI-visible type sizes such as wchar_t and 128-bit long double so the generic SPARC backend conforms to OpenBSD’s sparc64 ELF environment.
